description: Role an instructor plays on a course, such as lead or teaching assistant, used when assigning instructors to a course schedule and to set their pay rates. Add the categories your school uses before running payroll.

fields.description: Marks this category as counting toward the Instructor of Record designation for accreditation reporting.
fields.label: Is Instructor of Record?

fields.description: Rate history per pay mode. Mark the current rate Active; leave prior rates with Active unchecked to keep audit history. Only one Active row is allowed per Pay Mode.
fields.label: Rates

fields.description: Marks this category as one that assesses students in competency-based programs. Only these categories can be chosen as evaluators on a Competency Framework or as a student's mentor.
fields.label: Is Competency Evaluator?

fields.description: Course: assigned to a course schedule and assesses everyone in it. Program: assigned to a student on their program enrollment and follows them from course to course.
fields.label: Mentor Scope
On Their Sections
fields.description: What instructors in this category may do on the sections they are listed on. Program Chairs, Seminary Managers and the Registrar are not limited by these.

fields.label: Edits course content
fields.description: Course outline, lessons, assessments, late policy and student groups.

fields.label: Grades
fields.description: Grades and comments on submissions, due-date exceptions and sending final grades.

fields.label: Posts to the class
fields.description: Messages to all of the section's students, replies in discussions, and removing replies.

name: Instructor Category
